Headline: Employment contracts need urgent attention
What_this_score_means: Your responses suggest employment agreements may be missing, incomplete, or not updated when roles change. That creates ambiguity and increases dispute risk.
Recommended_actions: 1) Issue written contracts to all staff. 2) Cover Award/classification where relevant, hours, pay, leave, notice, and behaviour expectations. 3) Use variation letters when terms change. 4) Have templates reviewed before rollout.
Impact_of_improvement: Clear contracts reduce underpayment and unfair-dismissal exposure and set expectations from day one.
Support_and_resources: DreamStoneHR contract review; Fair Work Information Statement checklist

Headline: Solid base — close the gaps
What_this_score_means: You have some contracting foundations in place but coverage or content is inconsistent.
Recommended_actions: 1) Audit which roles lack a current signed agreement. 2) Standardise a clause checklist across templates. 3) Confirm variation letters are used whenever terms change.
Impact_of_improvement: Consistency makes performance and exit processes cleaner.

Headline: Strong contracting practice
What_this_score_means: Staff appear to be engaged on clear agreements with a process for changes.
Recommended_actions: 1) Review templates annually against Award and NES updates. 2) Spot-check files for signatures and current terms. 3) Keep training managers so variations are never skipped.
Impact_of_improvement: Staying current protects the documentation investment you have already made.

Headline: Psychosocial risk and Positive Duty need focused attention
What_this_score_means: A low score suggests significant gaps in how psychosocial risks are identified, managed and prevented — including sexual harassment and related Positive Duty obligations.
Recommended_actions: 1) Identify key psychosocial hazards. 2) Clarify behavioural expectations. 3) Strengthen safe reporting pathways. 4) Build leader capability on prevention and Positive Duty.
Impact_of_improvement: Better prevention improves wellbeing and reduces formal complaints and regulatory exposure.
Support_and_resources: Respect at Work & Positive Duty guidance; Psychological safety resources

Headline: Foundations exist — strengthen prevention
What_this_score_means: Some practices are in place but they are not yet consistent or fully embedded.
Recommended_actions: 1) Map hazards to owners and controls. 2) Train all leaders on early intervention. 3) Test that staff know how to raise concerns safely.
Impact_of_improvement: Moves the business from reactive handling to proactive prevention.

Headline: Strong prevention posture
What_this_score_means: Responses indicate clear expectations reporting pathways and leadership capability around psychosocial risk.
Recommended_actions: 1) Review controls after any incident or near miss. 2) Keep Positive Duty obligations visible in induction and leader training. 3) Measure psychological safety in engagement feedback.
Impact_of_improvement: Sustains trust and reduces the chance issues escalate into complaints.
Support_and_resources: Periodic Positive Duty health check with DreamStoneHR
